nodes.label: parseBaseEntryFields
nodes.rationale: Assembles shared BaseEntry fields from SourceRow using small pure parsers plus schema validation; keeps YAML row shaping in the functional core.

nodes.label: parseNoteBlock
nodes.rationale: Strict per-block validation; parseNoteBlocksFromSource leniently skips invalid array rows to tolerate messy source lists.

nodes.label: buildCheatPreamble
nodes.rationale: Cheat knowledge entries intentionally contribute no preamble text in assembled detail docs (always empty string).

nodes.label: buildBookmarkPreamble
nodes.rationale: YouTube URLs yield markdown link to the oembed embed URL plus an mqdefault thumbnail image line; non-YouTube URLs optionally render a preview image; otherwise preamble is empty.

nodes.label: assembleDoc
nodes.rationale: Composes the type-specific preamble with rendered note fragments into one Markdown detail document; accepts `now` as a parameter so overdue logic stays pure and tests stay deterministic.

nodes.label: assembleNotesDoc
nodes.rationale: Renders only note fragments (no type preamble), joined with blank lines, as a Result-wrapped string.

nodes.label: buildPreamble
nodes.rationale: Dispatches on `knowledge.type` to the correct preamble builder and passes `now` / optional preview image only where needed.

nodes.label: renderFragment
nodes.rationale: Turns a `(format, payload)` fragment into Markdown or image syntax: passthrough for md/markdown, base64 mermaid.ink PNG for mermaid, data-URL SVG, raw image URL for img, or fenced code for other formats.

nodes.label: renderNoteFragments
nodes.rationale: Maps notes through `parseNotes` then `renderFragment`, catching errors per fragment and emitting a fenced error block instead of failing the whole assembly.

nodes.label: buildTaskPreamble
nodes.rationale: Renders title, optional desc blockquote, STATUS/PRIORITY sections when present, and DUE DATE with OVERDUE suffix when due is before `now` and status is not done.

nodes.label: buildCommandPreamble
nodes.rationale: Renders a fenced `sh` block with the command key followed by a DESCRIPTION section with the desc as blockquote.

nodes.label: extractYouTubeId
nodes.rationale: Parses watch and youtu.be style URLs via URL API; returns null on invalid input or non-YouTube hosts.

nodes.label: youTubeThumbnail
nodes.rationale: HD maxresdefault JPEG URL; may 404 for some videos.

nodes.label: youTubeThumbnailMq
nodes.rationale: Smaller mqdefault thumbnail; documented as more reliable for detail previews than maxresdefault.

nodes.label: youTubeThumbnailCandidates
nodes.rationale: Ordered list of img.youtube.com JPEG stems from highest to lowest resolution for fallback fetching.

nodes.label: parseNotes
nodes.rationale: Normalises `RawNotes` (null, string, single object, or array of blocks) into a flat `NoteFragment[]` using the first string key of each object as format.

nodes.label: Four entry types (bookmark, command, cheat, task)
Cheat entry with PlantUML diagram note block
YouTube bookmark with markdown key insights notes
Bookmark with {Query} URL placeholder for search pages
Bookmark with titled external links array
Per-file bundle rollback on validation failure (partial failure semantic)
Command with markdown notes containing code blocks
Tasks covering all statuses (todo/doing/done) and priorities (low/mid/high/urgent)

hyperedges.label: Core domain type guards for entries, sections, and note langs
Renderer HTML shell → entry → React root
